description: Structured eval definitions for the DMS Endpoint Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across DMS endpoint scenarios (PostgreSQL source with CDC + Secrets Manager, Oracle source with Binary Reader + verify-full SSL, S3 target with Parquet format, MongoDB source with replica set CDC, PostgreSQL CDC with wal_level=replica prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: PostgreSQL source endpoint with CDC, Secrets Manager, and verify-full SSL
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — PostgreSQL source with pglogical plugin, Secrets Manager credentials, verify-full SSL, KMS encryption, wal_level=logical prerequisite verified
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DMS source endpoint for PostgreSQL at prod-db.cluster-abc123.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com port 5432, database analytics, us-east-1. Use Secrets Manager secret arn:aws:secretsmanager:us-east-1:123456789012:secret:dms-pg-prod. SSL mode verify-full with certificate prod-ca-cert. CDC enabled with pglogical plugin, slot name dms_replication_slot. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abc123. Replication instance rep-instance-prod. Tags: Environment=production, MigrationType=cdc.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DMS_ENDPOINT: pg-source-prod (postgres, source)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: postgres (port: 5432, database: analytics)
  [✓] Credentials: Secrets Manager
  [✓] SSL mode: verify-full
  [✓] Extra connection attributes: PluginName=pglogical;slotName=dms_replication_slot
  [✓] CDC prerequisites: MET (wal_level=logical)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws dms describe-endpoints --filters Name=endpoint-id,Values=pg-source-prod --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Oracle source endpoint with Binary Reader CDC and verify-full SSL
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Oracle source with Binary Reader, archived log tuning, verify-full SSL with imported certificate, supplemental logging prerequisite noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DMS source endpoint for Oracle at oracle-prod.example.com port 1521, SID ORCL, us-east-1. Use Binary Reader for CDC (useLogminerReader=N, AdditionalArchivedLogDestId=1). SSL mode verify-full with certificate oracle-ca-cert. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/oracle-key. Replication instance rep-instance-prod. Tags: Environment=production, Engine=oracle.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DMS_ENDPOINT: oracle-source-prod (oracle, source)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: oracle (port: 1521, SID: ORCL)
  [✓] SSL mode: verify-full (certificate: oracle-ca-cert)
  [✓] Extra connection attributes: useLogminerReader=N;AdditionalArchivedLogDestId=1
  [✓] CDC prerequisites: MET (supplemental logging enabled, ARCHIVELOG mode)

eval_cases.name: S3 target endpoint with Parquet format and Snappy compression
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — S3 target with Parquet DataFormat, Snappy CompressionType, RLE dictionary encoding, column names included
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DMS target endpoint for S3 in us-east-1. Bucket my-dms-target-bucket, folder /migration-data/. Data format Parquet with Snappy compression and RLE dictionary encoding. Include column names in output. Service access role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/dms-s3-role. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/s3-key. Replication instance rep-instance-prod. Tags: Environment=production, Format=parquet.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DMS_ENDPOINT: s3-target-parquet (s3, target)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: s3 (target)
  [✓] Extra connection attributes: DataFormat=parquet;CompressionType=snappy;EncodingType=rle-dictionary;AddColumnName=true
  [✓] Service access role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/dms-s3-role

eval_cases.name: MongoDB source endpoint with replica set for CDC
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — MongoDB source with replica set requirement noted, change streams CDC, NestingLevel=ONE, ExtractDocId=true
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DMS source endpoint for MongoDB at mongo-prod.example.com port 27017, us-east-1. Replica set rs0. CDC via change streams. NestingLevel=ONE, ExtractDocId=true, DocsToInvestigate=50. SSL mode require. Replication instance rep-instance-prod. Tags: Environment=production, Engine=mongodb.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DMS_ENDPOINT: mongo-source-prod (mongodb, source)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Engine: mongodb (port: 27017, replica set: rs0)
  [✓] Extra connection attributes: NestingLevel=ONE;ExtractDocId=true;DocsToInvestigate=50
  [✓] CDC prerequisites: MET (replica set, change streams enabled)

eval_cases.name: PostgreSQL CDC endpoint with wal_level=replica (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — PostgreSQL CDC requires wal_level=logical but source has wal_level=replica
eval_cases.prompt: Create a DMS source endpoint for PostgreSQL at staging-db.example.com port 5432, database staging, us-east-1. Enable CDC with pglogical plugin. The source database has wal_level=replica. Replication instance rep-instance-prod. Tags: Environment=staging.
eval_cases.expected_output:
DMS_ENDPOINT: pg-source-staging (postgres, source)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] CDC prerequisites: FAIL — wal_level=replica; CDC requires wal_level=logical
